title: Governed Founder Workstream Activation Planning
globalSafetyRules: Implement one subphase at a time.
P91 may only plan governed founder workstream activation after the exact subphase scopes and validates it.

Do not enable provider/model calls, agent dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, project creation, project mutation, DB writes, deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend unless that exact lane is separately scoped and validated.

Do not modify projects/**, careloop/**, generated app Sources/Tests, providers/**, tools/**, worker-runtime/**, db/**, prisma/**, migrations/**, deploy/**, release/**, exports/**, packages/**, or .env*.
Do not show DemoApp in full Command Center.
Do not show project/private raw IDs in primary UX.
Do not invent fake working actions.

subphases.objective: Define the governed founder workstream activation planning contract without enabling dispatch, mutation, or spend.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.dataShape: P91.1 is contract-only. P91.2 must define a local result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, activationMode, sourcePrd, workstreamLanes[], activationReadiness, allowedLocalOperations[], forbiddenOperations[], runtimeFlags, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, commandCenterVisible, and all unsafe runtime flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: Preserve existing Business Build and Lite UX. Later P91 UX must show workstream activation planning state, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner lanes, evidence, activity, and cost without showing runnable agent dispatch, project mutation, provider calls, raw JSON/logs, DemoApp, or raw private IDs.
playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P91.1 because no UI file changes.
P91 Command Center UX subphase must add focused coverage.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm P91.1 is contract-only.
Confirm no provider/model calls are enabled.
Confirm no agent, worker, tool, or executor dispatch is enabled.
Confirm no project creation, project mutation, DB write, deploy, release, export, package, network call, or spend is enabled.
Confirm no forbidden paths changed.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder workstream activation contract"
finalResponseChecklist: Docs, roadmap, and OS phase status updates
